commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
90+7' 1 - 1 Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) gets on the end of the corner kick deep inside the box and beats the keeper with a precise close-range shot into the bottom right corner.
90+6' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fulham.
90+6' This shall not pass! Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
90+5' Kenny Tete (Fulham) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot inches over the bar.
90+4' Diego Gomez (Brighton) commits a foul during an attacking move.
90+3' A yellow card for a tackle by Tom Cairney (Fulham). Samuel Barrott doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+2' Flag goes up against Brajan Gruda (Brighton) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
88' The substitution is prepared. James Milner (Brighton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matt O'Riley.
87' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the left post. Unlucky!
86' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
85' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
84' Here is a change. Jorge Cuenca is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Timothy Castagne (Fulham).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Brajan Gruda (Brighton) will replace Kaoru Mitoma.
81' Some great controlled play and passing from Brighton. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
78' Samuel Barrott shows the yellow card to Diego Gomez (Brighton) for a heavy challenge.
77' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Joshua King will be replaced by Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham).
76' Diego Gomez (Brighton) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance low towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno is alert and makes a decent save.
75' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) is adjudged offside.
73' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
72' The shots on goal statistics – 3:1.
71' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
70' Diego Gomez (Brighton) was too forceful with his tackle and Samuel Barrott interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) is coming onto the pitch as Yankuba Minteh cannot continue after picking up an injury.
69' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Danny Welbeck (Brighton) replacing Georginio Rutter.
69' Carlos Baleba will be replaced by Diego Gomez (Brighton).
66' Substitution. Alex Iwobi will be replaced by Adama Traore (Fulham).
66' The game has come to an end for Raul Jimenez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).
66' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Sander Berge and he is replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
65' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
65' Fulham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
63' Dangerous play by Georginio Rutter (Brighton). Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
61' PENALTY APPEAL after Calvin Bassey (Fulham) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
60' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) earns the yellow card.
60' The foul by Raul Jimenez (Fulham) was seen by Samuel Barrott who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
58' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.
55' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Matt O'Riley (Brighton) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Bernd Leno no chance!
55' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
53' Sander Berge (Fulham) jumps into a tackle and Samuel Barrott signals a foul. The referee gives a penalty kick to Brighton!!
51' Brighton hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
48' Half-chance! Joshua King (Fulham) plays a pass into the box, but Bart Verbruggen reacts well to snuff out the attack.
47' The referee blows his whistle as Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) was too aggressive in his challenge.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) whips in a cross from the corner, but Bernd Leno is well positioned and punches the ball away.
44' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Brighton get a corner.
43' Harry Wilson (Fulham) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar.

43' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the target, but Bernd Leno keeps the ball out.
42' Sander Berge (Fulham) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
41' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) sends a chip pass into the box, but Bernd Leno is quickest to intercept the ball.
41' Brighton earn a corner.
40' The resulting set piece from Brighton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
40' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
39' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
38' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Georginio Rutter (Brighton). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
35' The percentage of ball possession is – 53:47.
33' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is caught offside!
31' Booking. Calvin Bassey (Fulham) receives a caution from the referee.
30' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle and signals a foul after Sasa Lukic (Fulham) brought his opponent down.
28' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar!
27' Brighton keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
26' Some great play by Georginio Rutter (Brighton) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Bernd Leno sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
25' Harry Wilson (Fulham) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.

24' Joshua King (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fulham.
22' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) sends a chip pass into the box, but Bernd Leno is quickest to intercept the ball.
21' A pass by Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
20' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
19' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
18' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul after Joachim Andersen (Fulham) hacks down one of his opponents.
16' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
14' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Harry Wilson (Fulham) heads on.
12' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) commits a rough challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Fulham as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
9' There's a break in play and referee Samuel Barrott must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Fulham using VAR. This could be interesting!
8' Joshua King (Fulham) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
7' Kenny Tete (Fulham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bart Verbruggen intercepts the ball.
7' A clumsy foul by Mats Wieffer (Brighton) and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle.
5' After what seems an eternity, referee Samuel Barrott decides the ball went out of play after using VAR to review the goal! NO GOAL for Brighton, play to continue.
4' The ball is in the net, but referee Samuel Barrott makes the VAR signal straight away as he clearly wants to check to see if the ball went out of play. Let’s see what happens!
2' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
1' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
